images.title: The road trip map
images.purpose: Give the revision a single picture: one road with one signpost for each main idea of the chapter, in the order of the lessons.
images.composition: One winding road in four legs with fifteen signposts, each with a short label and no working.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. One winding road with fifteen signposts. THE ROAD is a thick construction grey #6B7280 line (14 px) in four horizontal legs joined by half circles of radius 100 px: leg 1 at y 170 from x 120 to x 1290 running left to right; a half circle on the right from (1290, 170) down to (1290, 370), reaching x 1390; leg 2 at y 370 from x 1290 to x 120 running right to left; a half circle on the left from (120, 370) down to (120, 570), reaching x 20; leg 3 at y 570 from x 120 to x 1290 running left to right; a half circle on the right from (1290, 570) down to (1290, 770); leg 4 at y 770 from x 1290 to x 330 running right to left. Small white chevrons (5 px lines, 30 px tall) on the road show the direction: on legs 1 and 3 pointing right at x 375, 705 and 1035; on leg 2 pointing left at x 1035, 705 and 375; on leg 4 pointing left at x 1035 and 705. At the end of leg 4, at x 330, a small flag: a thin dark #2B2B2B pole (4 px, y 700 to 770) with a rectangular flag 50 by 34 px filled reddish purple #CC79A7 at its top. FIFTEEN SIGNPOSTS, each made of a stop circle on the road (36 px across, filled amber #E69F00, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px), a thin dark post (6 px) rising from the stop circle 60 px, and a board on top of the post: a rounded rectangle 300 by 90 px, centred on the stop x, from 150 px to 60 px above the road, white fill, outlined teal #0072B2 4 px, with its label in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (30 px) centred, on two lines or one as given. LEG 1, the road at y 170 running left to right: signposts Balancing sums at x 210 (two lines); Adding by place value at x 540 (two lines); Near-round numbers at x 870 (two lines); Subtraction and its link at x 1200 (two lines); LEG 2, the road at y 370 running right to left: signposts Consecutive sums at x 1200 (two lines); Pair the ends at x 870 (two lines); Large numbers at x 540 (two lines); Journey problems at x 210 (two lines); LEG 3, the road at y 570 running left to right: signposts Quick sums and differences at x 210 (two lines); Palindromes at x 540 (one line); Number grids at x 870 (two lines); Even and odd and their sums at x 1200 (two lines); LEG 4, the road at y 770 running right to left: signposts Coins at x 1200 (one line); A torch at x 870 (one line); Tables at x 540 (one line). The road passes the signposts in this order, one to fifteen. No numbers and no working anywhere. No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: Even and odd and their sums
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any number, sum or working on a signpost
more or fewer than fifteen signposts
more than one road or a road that branches
any text other than the fifteen short labels
labels longer than the ones listed, or labels overlapping the road or each other
images.takeaway: The chapter is one road trip with fifteen signposts, one for each main idea.
images.description: One winding road with fifteen signposts: balancing sums, adding by place value, near-round numbers, subtraction and its link, consecutive sums, pair the ends, large numbers, journey problems, quick sums and differences, palindromes, number grids, even and odd and their sums, coins, a torch and tables.
images.context: Summary image for the Chapter Revision: the final journey map. It shows the ideas only, with short labels, no numbers.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say one thing about each signpost as the road is driven.

image_decisions.why: A single map with one signpost for each main idea of the chapter helps the student walk through the revision.
